Class XMLReader

java.lang.Object
common.xml.XMLReader
All Implemented Interfaces:
CommonConstants, EngineNodeConstants, XMLConstantNames
public class XMLReader extends Object implements XMLConstantNames, CommonConstants

Title: XML Reader

Description: Reads model information from an XML file. This class provides methods for model load.

  • Method Details

    • loadModel

      public static boolean loadModel(String fileName, CommonModel model)
      Loads a model saved in an XML file, given the name of the file. If specified file is a jmodel archive, extracts model informations from it and uses them to reconstruct the model. This method is provided to be used with JSIM
      Parameters:
      fileName - name of the file to be opened
      model - data structure where model should be created (a new data structure is the best choice)
      Returns:
      true iff model was recognized and loaded, false otherwise
